_source: Compiled from hadolint rules (DL3000-DL4006), Docker official best-practices guide, OWASP Docker Security Cheatsheet, NIST SP 800-190 controls. Last refresh: 2026-06-15. Each rule is regex-matchable against tokenized Dockerfile RUN/ENV/COPY/FROM/EXPOSE lines.
_notes: Supplements the hadolint binary already wrapped in _probe_hadolint_dockerfile — these are rules NOT covered by hadolint (downloads from typosquatted hosts, hardcoded production URLs, dangerous package patterns, etc.).

rules.name: ADD with remote URL (use COPY + curl/wget instead)
rules.fix: ADD with URL skips signature verification and integrity checks. Use: RUN curl -fSL <url> -o /tmp/x && sha256sum -c expected.sha256 && mv /tmp/x /opt/x

rules.name: wget without certificate verification (--no-check-certificate)
rules.fix: Remove --no-check-certificate. If cert is broken, fix the cert chain — don't disable verification.

rules.name: curl without certificate verification (-k / --insecure)
rules.fix: Remove -k/--insecure. Establish proper CA trust before fetching.

rules.name: pip install --trusted-host (bypasses TLS check)
rules.fix: Remove --trusted-host. PyPI mirror should have a valid TLS cert.

rules.name: npm install with --no-package-lock or --ignore-scripts=false
rules.fix: Always commit package-lock.json + install with --frozen-lockfile / npm ci for reproducible builds.

rules.name: Hardcoded production URL in ENV / build arg
rules.fix: Move environment-specific URLs to runtime injection (Kubernetes ConfigMap, --env-file at docker run).

rules.name: USER 0 / USER root (explicit root)
rules.fix: Use a non-zero UID. RUN groupadd -r appuser && useradd -r -g appuser appuser && USER appuser.

rules.name: Sudo installed in image
rules.fix: Containers should not need sudo. Set USER appropriately or use Kubernetes securityContext.

rules.name: Telnet / rsh / rlogin installed (insecure remote access)
rules.fix: Use 'docker exec' / 'kubectl exec' for debugging. Never ship cleartext remote-access daemons.

rules.name: FTP/TFTP server installed
rules.fix: FTP transmits credentials in cleartext. Use SFTP/SCP at runtime, or remove if not strictly required.

rules.name: chmod 777 anywhere in RUN
rules.fix: World-writable+executable is rarely needed. Use chmod 755 (or 750 / 700 for sensitive paths).

rules.name: chmod 666 anywhere in RUN
rules.fix: World-writable is rarely needed. Use chmod 644 or scope to the specific path.

rules.name: RUN as sudo (sudo in shell line)
rules.fix: Switch USER before the RUN, don't sudo inside it. Saves a layer + removes sudo dependency.

rules.name: ENV with DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive (should be ARG)
rules.fix: Use ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive so it doesn't persist in the runtime image's env.

rules.name: Latest tag in FROM (no version pin)
rules.fix: Pin to a specific tag or digest: FROM image:1.21 or FROM image@sha256:...  'latest' is mutable.

rules.name: FROM without a tag at all (implicit latest)
rules.fix: FROM with no tag is equivalent to :latest. Always pin: FROM image:1.21.

rules.name: Layer-cache buster (RUN echo $(date))
rules.fix: Cache busters break reproducible builds. Use --no-cache only when needed.

rules.name: Hardcoded internal IP / RFC1918 address
rules.fix: Internal IPs in the image rarely survive cluster moves. Use service DNS (e.g. svc.namespace.svc.cluster.local).

rules.name: Build secret leaked via ARG that mirrors a known secret name
rules.fix: ARG values are visible in `docker history`. Use BuildKit secret mounts: RUN --mount=type=secret,id=mysecret cat /run/secrets/mysecret.

rules.name: WORKDIR is /  / /tmp / /var/log (broken-by-design)
rules.fix: Use a dedicated /app or /srv/<service> directory. Tmpfs paths are wiped on restart.

rules.name: COPY . . (whole repo copied — leaks .git, .env, node_modules)
rules.fix: Always ship a .dockerignore. At minimum exclude: .git, .env*, node_modules, .vscode, .idea, *.log, .terraform, .DS_Store.

rules.name: git clone without --depth 1 (full history in image)
rules.fix: Use 'git clone --depth 1 --single-branch'. Full repo history bloats the image and may leak secrets from old commits.

rules.name: RUN with multi-step package install + missing cleanup
rules.fix: After apt-get install, run: && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*. Otherwise package cache bloats the image by ~30 MB.

rules.name: Running a shell script piped from network (curl | sh)
rules.fix: Pipe-to-shell is unverifiable code. Download → checksum → execute as 3 steps.

rules.name: Disable SSL/TLS verification env var
rules.fix: Don't disable TLS verification globally. Fix the underlying cert/CA issue.

rules.name: Hardcoded JDBC URL with password
rules.fix: Move DB credentials to a Kubernetes Secret / Vault and inject at runtime.

rules.name: Long-running CMD as PID 1 without exec / dumb-init
rules.fix: Use exec form: CMD ["./app"]. Shell form doesn't forward SIGTERM, breaking graceful shutdown in Kubernetes.

rules.name: VOLUME for sensitive runtime paths (/etc/secrets, /var/run/secrets)
rules.fix: Don't declare secret paths as VOLUMEs. K8s mounts secrets automatically as projected volumes.

rules.name: Heredoc that may leak interpolation
rules.fix: Heredocs interpolate build-time env. Be explicit about which variables can land in the layer.

rules.name: EXPOSE 0.0.0.0 anywhere (informational malformation)
rules.fix: EXPOSE only takes ports, not addresses. Bind decisions belong at runtime (-p 0.0.0.0:8080).

rules.name: Build-time install of compiler in final stage
rules.fix: Use multi-stage build: FROM x AS build ... FROM x AS runtime. Compilers in production image expand attack surface.

rules.name: SSH server (sshd/openssh-server) installed in image
rules.fix: Containers should not run an SSH daemon. Use 'kubectl exec' / 'docker exec' for shell access — one process per container.

rules.name: apt-key add (deprecated, no keyring isolation)
rules.fix: apt-key is deprecated and trusts keys globally. Use signed-by: write the key to /etc/apt/keyrings/<name>.gpg and reference it in the .list/.sources file.

rules.name: GPG/key fetch over insecure hkp:// or http:// keyserver
rules.fix: Fetch keys over hkps:// (TLS) or pin a vendored .gpg file copied into the image and verified by fingerprint.

rules.name: pip install without --no-cache-dir (cache bloats image)
rules.fix: Add --no-cache-dir to pip install. The wheel cache is dead weight in the final image and can retain stale/yanked artifacts.

rules.name: MAINTAINER instruction (deprecated)
rules.fix: MAINTAINER is deprecated. Use a LABEL: LABEL org.opencontainers.image.authors="team@example.com".

rules.name: ADD of local archive auto-extracted into image (silent tar extraction)
rules.fix: ADD auto-extracts archives — surprising and bypasses integrity checks. Prefer COPY + an explicit, checksummed 'RUN tar -xf'.

rules.name: Disabling host-key checking for SSH/git in RUN
rules.fix: Disabling StrictHostKeyChecking exposes builds to MITM. Pin the host key (vendored known_hosts) instead of accepting any key.
